title: Changing the person on a part sale's status card saves
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • 1 technicians eligible at this location: active, Role Technician, at least one Department, Location Staging Heavy Duty - 9919, Time Clock on. Names are examples ("Esther Howard").
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST Part Sale Person" (used by this case only) with one contact.
  • One part sale [PS-1] for that customer with one part.

Setup

  1. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff: if no suitable technician exists, click New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = any one (at least one Department is required) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-A] (the expected results call this technician "Esther Howard").
  2. Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST Part Sale Person" > Save (the customer page opens). Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name "ZZAUTOTEST", Last Name "Contact" > Save. Assets tab > New Asset > Contact = ZZAUTOTEST Contact > Year 2022 > Make: type "Freight" and pick Freightliner > Model: type "M2" and pick it > Unit "TRK-118" > Save (Contact and Make are required).
  3. Click Parts in the top menu > Part Sales > New Part Sale > Customer: type and pick "ZZAUTOTEST Part Sale Person" (add it first with Customers > New Customer if missing) > Save (if a Confirmation about the credit limit appears, click Create). The part sale page opens; record the number at the top left as [PS-1] (the expected results call it "PS-1001").
  4. On the Parts tab click Add Part > Description "Brake Pads" > Quantity 1 > Category Uncategorized > Vendor: pick any > Cost 100 > Sell Price 290.91 > Save & Close.
  5. Check the setup worked: [PS-1] opens and its status card shows Contact and Authorizer.
custom_steps:
1. Click Parts in the top menu, then Part Sales.
  2. Click the [PS-1] row in the Part Sales list to open it.
  3. On the status card pick a different person in the technician field (on part sales it may read Sales Representative), e.g. [Tech-A]. If the card has no technician or Sales Representative field, write the fields you see.
  4. Reload the page and read the field.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the change saves with no error message.
  • Step 4: the field still shows "Esther Howard".

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): The part sale status card shows Contact, Phone, Authorizer and Asset; there is no technician or Sales Representative field to change. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.
